 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The thick of the Alabama high school football postseason continues as AHSAA teams are one step closer to a Blue Map trophy and AISA brackets have rounded out.
 The third round of the AHSAA football playoffs kicked off Friday, Nov. 20. Four rounds determine which public-school teams advance to the state championships Dec. 2-5 in Mobile. Private schools in Single A and Double A have one less round, meaning the winners of the semifinal matchups this week will secure a spot in the state championship games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement See final scores from the third round of the 2026 Alabama high school football playoffs around the state below. 
 THANKSGIVING WEEKEND FOOTBALL: See the brackets for the AHSAA semifinal round 
 SINGLE A BRACKET: Tuscaloosa Academy gives all in AHSAA playoff loss to Westbrook Christian 
 CLASS 5A BRACKET: Hillcrest football stays alive in AHSAA playoffs with thriller vs Saraland 
 Watch AHSAA high school football games on the NFHS Network
 Most of the Tuscaloosa-area football programs are available to stream on the NFHS Network. It is a subscription service which costs $13.99 but gives to access to all content on the site, across all sports.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It is up to schools to provide the stream, so it's not a guarantee all games in all sports will be available, but most area schools look to have at least some football games on the site.
